_comment: Manual corrections to bout.cardSection for events where the Cito API gets it wrong. The update-odds workflow re-fetches data/event.json from scratch every run and would otherwise silently wipe these fixes — apply-card-section-overrides.js re-applies every entry here on top of the fresh fetch before it's committed. Add an entry whenever a card placement is wrong; remove it once the upstream API fixes itself (or once the event has passed).

overrides.reason: Cito API labeled the entire card 'Main Card' (no prelims split). These 6 bouts are actually prelims per the official card.
